title: Autosens feature not shown in settings
body:
AAPS 3.4.0.0
When using OpenAPS AMA mode the function "Use Autosens feature" is not shown in the AMA settings menu.

I had to use the search function in the settings menu to find it, and as the picture shows it is meant to be in the AMA settings menu. 

Please see attached screenshots. Top picture is from the settings menu item, where it is missing. Seconde picture is using the search feature, where it is found. 

Bas Geurds

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a167ab72-4b79-4078-92f2-5ecd93f888d2)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/457d7282-e3ed-4fb9-a97d-c9c5bf208556)

comments.body:
I reproduced the bug in dev environment. I will share a workaround.
1) activate SMB algorithm
2) go to its settings and disable dynamic sensitivity
3) go back to AMA algo again, you should see the option as expected.

I'll start looking at a possible fix.

#5013 is now merged to dev so this issue can be closed. When AAPS 4.0.0 is released this bug will be fixed. Thanks for reporting.

@MilosKozak or @basgeurds please close this issue :)

Hi Milos and team,

Thank you so much for your continuous support and improvements, which helps
me a lot to get my T1D better in control.

Kind regards,
Bas Geurds
